Standalone WER is not how a model performs in the ensemble — a mediocre solo model can still add a valuable decorrelated vote. Use this to see raw model quality; use Rankings for ensemble performance.

Merge = validated consensus core (identical to the offline sweep). WER is compound-aware & punctuation-agnostic (canon). Replays stored transcripts through the merge — not a live provider test.
